Why Formester for Canva

Why Choose Our Canva Form Builder Plugin?

Create Fillable Forms

Easily add interactive, fillable forms to your Canva website without any coding. Customize colors, fonts, layouts, and fields to match your brand perfectly.

Pre-Built Templates

Save time with ready-made form templates for Canva! Choose from contact forms, feedback forms, sign-up forms, event registrations, and more.

Easy Embedding

Embedding forms in Canva is super easy! Just copy the embed code from Formester and paste it into your Canva website.

How it works

How to Add Forms to Your Canva Website in Minutes

1

Create a Form in Formester

Use Formester’s drag-and-drop form builder or AI Form Generator to design your form in minutes. Choose from pre-made templates or build a custom form from scratch.

2

Customize to Match Your Canva Website

Adjust layouts, colors, and fonts to blend perfectly with your Canva website. Add smart features like conditional logic, multi-step forms, and file uploads.

3

Embed the Form in Canva

Once your form is ready, open Canva Apps and search for Formester. Copy your form’s URL from Formester, paste it into the plugin, and select Add to Design. Your form will be instantly embedded into your Canva website.

4

Collect Responses & Analyze Data

Start collecting submissions in real time! Use Formester’s built-in form analytics to track responses. Connect your forms to Google Sheets for easy organization and reporting.

Advanced

Advanced Features of Canva form builder

Secure Payment Collection

Turn your Canva forms into order forms, donation pages, or registration forms by accepting secure payments via PayPal and Stripe. No extra setup needed, just enable payments and start collecting!

Email Auto-Responders

Send automatic confirmation emails to users after they submit a form using the email auto responder. You can customize these emails with personalized messages, attachments, or follow-up instructions.

Spam & Bot Protection

Protect your forms from spam and fake submissions with reCAPTCHA, Turnstile and advanced spam protection. Ensure you receive only genuine responses without any hassle.

GDPR-Compliant Forms

Keep user data secure and comply with privacy regulations. Formester ensures that your forms meet GDPR standards, so you can collect information with confidence.
